The '''gentler rod''' was a type of double-strength [[Stun baton/Legends|stun baton]] that was popular among [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]], who used them to discipline captives that they did not want to [[Death/Legends|kill]]. The rods were also used by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], and some Hutts disguised their gentler rods as ornamental accessories, such as [[Scepter/Legends|scepters]]. Gentler rods weighed 2.2[[Kilogram/Legends|kg]] and cost 1000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to purchase.<ref name="TF" />
